steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a boil over medium heat, and stir in the rhubarb; simmer for 2 minutes to blanch. Drain in a colander set in the sink, and let cool.
Stir together the cooled rhubarb, apple, green onions, lime juice, honey, and jalapeno pepper until thoroughly combined.

raw_recipe.headline: Rhubarb Salsa
raw_recipe.description: Rhubarb makes a great addition to a springtime salsa that's so nice with chicken, fish, on a taco, or just scooped up in a tortilla chip.
raw_recipe.name: Rhubarb Salsa

review.reviewBody: This was wonderful! I've made it a couple of times now. We've used it for to top chips, put on grilled chicken and used it in halibut tacos. I once made it with lemon juice because I didn't have enough lime and it turned out just as wonderful. I also add cilantro. I would make it a day ahead and let it sit in the fridge so all the flavors can meld together. You should definitely try this!! I had friends come over that immediately asked for the recipe. Thanks!

I added some fresh basil, which I had on hand but another fresh herb would be nice. It also needs salt. The salt wakes up the fruit and actually makes the salsa sweeter. It was pretty tart before the salt. I might also decrease the onions, which are overpowering. I'll refrigerate it and see if it tastes better the next day. A decent recipe if you have rhubarb to get rid of, but there are better salsas out there.

Oh my! We all loved this.
I was given some rhubarb from a friend's garden, but I didn't want to make anything with it that required lots of sugar. When I found this recipe I was curious, and had everything I needed to make it. I followed the recipe exactly, except that I added a little cilantro, and since I had organic limes, I also added the lime zest, which I grated with my microplane. I topped tostadas with this salsa. It has such depths of flavors that it gave the tostadas a "restaurant quality" flavor. My husband is already asking for it again, and he isn't even a fan of rhubarb.
I made this in the morning so it had plenty of time to chill, and for the flavors to mingle by the time dinner rolled around. Really looking forward to having this again.

My dear friend, Shawna, has a huge garden and gave me the most lovely rhubarb. It was so fresh and it's flavor quite strong so I used the 2 cups of rhubarb then doubled everything else. Took another's suggestion and added fresh strawberries too. Fabulous! The next night I added some avocado to make it more of a guacamole! Great!

I really enjoyed it, but it wasn't spicy enough for me. I will try again adding more jalapenos (unseeded with a little less lime juice). I gave some to my neighbor and she loved it, as is, and asked for the recipe.

I made this salsa today, I used a whole red pepper instead of a jalapeño pepper as my family doesn't like them. This is amazing. I also used Palm Flower Honey that brought from Hawaii. I hope my family likelikes it as much as I do.

Awesome! This is a great way to use rhubarb without a lot of sugar. The lime and the apples make this delicious. 
I didn't have green onions so I used red onion and chives. I added a little Kosher salt. 
I'm guessing that if you thaw frozen rhubarb there would be no need to blanch it. 
I ate it with chips, but you could do a lot with this.

This recipe was fantastic. I caught my 15 year old daughter "sampling" it from the fridge while I grilling the chicken to put it on. 

I stuck to the recipe except for one addition. I added a couple sprigs of chopped cilantro, and I think that added the perfect finishing touch. 

One mistake I made was in blanching the rhubarb too long. I lost more flavor than I intended. I also would add a second jalapeno next time. I added one per the recipe and couldn't get a lot from it... and that's something for me to say since I'm a wuss when things are too hot.
Loved it only thing I did different was I didn't blanch the rhubarb. It gave it a little bit of a crunch.

This was very good. My 3 yr old grandson loved it. I didn't use limes, I used 4 Tablespoons of lime juice and instead of jalapeno's I used salsa peppers and I also added a half can of rinsed and drained black beans

The salsa is delicious and interesting. I always was looking for the no dessert rhubarb recipes and that is. I used the salsa on potatoes, but we found it would be better with bread or tortilla chips. I didn`t have honey and used brown sugar instead that worked well. And I had big limes, so 1 lime was enough too. Thanks for a great rhubarb recipe.
it's very Fantastic.
This was really tasty and very quick to make. I took another reviewer’s advice to add some salt, and I would recommend that as well.

I made this recipe once for a potluck. It wasn't my favourite. But, it got great reviews from the other potluck guests and a couple people asked me for the recipe. They were very surprised that rhubarb was the main ingredient.
Oh this was so good! No other comment!
I was skeptical because when I blanched the rhubarb it looked very unappealing but mixing it all together and it tasted amazing!
It was fantastic although watery. I would definitely make it again.
Very good and easy to make. Served with chicken and was a big hit. Will make again.
meh. It wasn't a waste of food, but we didn't care for it enough to ever make it again.
Very good! Thank you!
